narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a social advice segment aimed at empowering women to set healthy boundaries. The speaker warns against the 'reciprocity trap' where one person shares a secret or vulnerability to force the other to do the same, emphasizing that mutual sharing should be a choice, not an obligation.
